phase: Sixty citizens instead of twelve. Seventeen rounds could not decide a single indicator, and v17 showed why: four seeds only redraw the same twelve people, so the person-level variance never falls. This is the first run where the roster itself is larger.
primary: The seventeen answer-key indicators. The power note puts 53 citizens behind a 3,000 KRW mechanism effect and 106 behind a candidate difference, so sixty reaches the first line and not the second.
limitations: Sixty citizens, one seed. Enough for a mechanism sign by the power note, not for a candidate difference.
The cohort is disjoint from the original twelve and stratified by weekday spending decile; it was drawn before any result was seen.
Duty kind derives from each persona job; stocks alternate 0/2 by sorted index, the rule the original twelve used.
Gate-blocked cells are repaired by the loop and the matrix stays incomplete by construction.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair carried from v16/v17 (experiments/v18/prompt_v18.md). No new candidate.
